text:
Hi, I’m Mina Castellan, and I’m a passionate, hard-working data professional with 5 years of experience helping businesses turn raw data into clear, actionable insights.

I’m interested in your project covering Facebook ads, Instagram promotion, Twitter promotions, TikTok promotion, and YouTube marketing because I have extensive experience with data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. I’m comfortable working with SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets, and I focus on making performance data easier to understand so you can make better marketing decisions.

In a recent project, Warehouse models for a DTC brand (Fernwood Pantry), I built a dbt project with staging, intermediate, and mart layers for orders, subscriptions, and marketing. That work included 38 models and tests on 120 columns, and it helped support a dashboard refresh from daily to hourly.

I also worked on Marketing attribution analysis for Verdant Skincare, where I joined ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit. As a result, 18% of the ad budget was reallocated, and customer acquisition cost went down 12% the next quarter.

For a campaign like yours, I can help organize the performance data across channels, clean and structure the numbers, and create dashboards that make it easier to compare results across Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, TikTok, and YouTube. I understand how important it is to see which platforms are driving reach, engagement, and efficiency, and I can help you build a reporting setup that supports those decisions.

I’m reliable, detail-oriented, and easy to work with. If you’re looking for someone who can bring strong analytical thinking and clear reporting to your marketing efforts, I’d be glad to help.
